title: A Múlt Idő: Szabályos és Rendhagyó Igék

sections.title: Bringing Units 24 and 25 together
sections.content: Regular verbs add -t- (or -ott-/-ett-/-ött- with a linking vowel) plus the ordinary personal endings: dolgoztam, dolgoztál, dolgozott... A handful of verbs switch to a special past stem instead: van → volt-, megy → ment-, jön → jött-, eszik → evett-/ette, iszik → ivott-/itta, vesz → vett-/vette. And the definite/indefinite split from the present carries straight into the past: an indefinite object (egy kabátot, or none) takes the plain ending, a definite one (a kabátot, a name, a possessive) takes the -m/-d/-i-family definite ending.

sections.content: The same test as always decides definite or indefinite: could you point at exactly one thing right now? a/az, a possessive, or a name → definite. egy or nothing → indefinite. This holds whichever tense you're in.
